_comment: Machine-scope (host-global) skill registry — shared once across every project on the machine, installed at the host level, never per-repo. source_fetched entries: `pfm install` fetches each from its canonical public repo (always latest) and links it into every Claude account's skills/ and ~/.agents/skills/; single source of truth — the blueprint never holds a copy of these registry skills that can silently drift; refresh/export MUST NOT re-vendor them, it only maintains this list. templates/project/skills/sources.json keeps only project-scope entries.
